Dedupe is in at `src/router.js:29`. `createState()` now returns `{ lastSentAt: Map }`, keyed by `event.key`; a repeat inside the window returns `[]`, and the timestamp only advances on an actual send (so a drop doesn't extend the window indefinitely).

Spot-check: at 600 `high` sends, 602 and 604 drop, 605 sends again (window elapsed), 611 sends.

Replay: `dropped: 99` — the flap events from `events.js`, which fire 2 minutes after their predecessor. 900 events, 0 errors.

One judgment call: I read "in the last 5 minutes" as a strict window, so a repeat exactly 5 minutes later goes through. Change `DEDUPE_MINUTES` comparison to `<=` if you want 5 minutes itself suppressed.
